S109.16.needs: a Slack workspace where you can add apps, and a Slack account; the app must be configured by the owner first (see note)
S109.16.note: Partly built: the Slack routes exist (apps/web/app/api/webhooks/slack/route.ts, apps/web/lib/slack/slack-config.ts) but the owner still has to create the Slack app and set SLACK_APP_CLIENT_ID, SLACK_APP_CLIENT_SECRET and SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, and migration 0333 must be applied. Teams, WhatsApp and Telegram have no chat-with-AGI path in the code: they appear only as connectors (Settings > Customize > Connectors, apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts), which send and read messages but do not answer a person there. The step that opens the Settings modal from the first screen was not confirmed in code; the modal title "Settings" is in packages/ui/ui/src/settings-modal/SettingsModal.tsx.
steps: Sign in to the web app and open Settings.
In the "Slack workspaces you added" card, click "Add to Slack". Slack's install page opens in the browser.
Approve the app in Slack. Come back to Settings and look for the message "AGI was added to Slack. Send it a message there to start."

In Slack, send AGI a direct message or mention it in a channel after /invite-ing it. Click the link it sends to connect your Slack account, then check that "Your Slack accounts" in Settings lists your account and that AGI answers in the thread.
S109.16.where: Settings > Customize > Slack app > "Add to Slack" (then message AGI in Slack)
